proposed_projection_convention.straight: independent dot products against unit directions; normals positive left
proposed_projection_convention.curved: closest projection onto polyline, with first and last tangent rays for out-of-range coverage
proposed_projection_convention.longitudinal: signed arc length from first stored vertex; tangent-ray extensions may be negative
proposed_projection_convention.lateral: signed cross(unit segment tangent, point minus projected point), positive left
proposed_projection_convention.ties: smallest longitudinal value, then smallest segment index at a shared vertex
proposed_projection_convention.all_points: evaluate both objects against the same complete descriptor set
proposed_projection_convention.extension_warning: flag use of extrapolated tangent rays; do not present them as observed flow

scope: descriptive exploration on these 26 encounters; not held-out validation or CB reproduction
